strategies.name: mean_reversion_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: After price stretches too far too fast into a clearly defined support or resistance level, enter when the tape shows order-flow hesitation/reversal: sellers stop hitting the bid into support for a long, or buyers exhaust into resistance for a short. The trader takes the offer to get long in front of
strategies.exit_summary: Use the bids/offers at the key level as protection, implying a tight stop if the support/resistance fails, and seek to capture the bounce/reversal off that level as the scalp profit.

variants.variant_label: long into sharp flush at support
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: volume stalls and sellers stop hitting the bid into support; enter by taking the offer long in front of support
variants.transcript_quote: On a sharp down move into support, you will often see a moment where volume stalls... you then take the offer and get long in front of that support

variants.variant_label: short into sharp extension at resistance

strategies.name: continuation_breakout_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Enter on a clean break of support or resistance, trying to be first in as the level gives way. For an upside breakout, buy just above resistance (for example $10.01/$10.02 or $50.01) when tape and level-two show buyers aggressively lifting the offer and the offer shrinking or getting taken.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop right back below the broken level if price fails back through it, and scalp out into the emotional follow-through shortly after the break, often for 10 to 30 cents when momentum expands quickly.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: buy immediately above a clean resistance break
variants.transcript_quote: if we have a $10 resistance level, you want to be buying $10.01 or $10.02, and scalping out on that emotional follow-through

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: multiple pushes into $50, shallow pullbacks, buyers lifting the offer, offer size shrinking then disappearing
variants.target_note: kick it out 10, 20, or even 30 cents higher
variants.transcript_quote: if buyers continue lifting and the offer size begins to shrink, then suddenly it's gone, you want to be the one buying at $50.01

strategies.name: spread_making_scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Instead of taking liquidity, place resting limit orders ahead of large bids or offers in liquid names with a meaningful spread, intending to buy the bid/sell the offer as urgent participants cross the market. The edge comes from providing liquidity in relative equilibrium rather than predicting a短期動
strategies.exit_summary: Quickly offer out the acquired shares one or two points higher to capture the spread, and repeat while the spread remains wide before it compresses or the stock drifts enough to remove the edge.
